lane_budget.admission_rule: Before each stage: remaining = 14400 - 1.832 - sum of census CPU of every earlier v4 stage including failures and audits. Admit only if the stage's worst_case_cpu <= remaining; otherwise stop and report blocked-on-budget. No threshold or limit change.
